messages:
maria: Heads-up — I found blobs that look like KMS-wrapped ciphertext inside a partner staging backup we pulled for repro. filenames: partner-staging-2026-03-22.tar.gz. Not sure if any plaintext creds leaked but need a containment plan.
ajay: ugh. do we know which KMS key id is referenced in the ciphertext header? can you paste a sample header (no ciphertext) or the metadata?
maria: sample header: `alg=RSA-OAEP-256; key_id=projects/redwood-kms/keys/partner-integ-2025; wrapped=true` — I redacted the base64 payload.
tom: if it's that key, we should assume partner-sa access might be implicated. quick triage: 1) confirm if any active service accounts have that key in IAM 2) check audit logs for Unwrap/Decrypt requests in last 90d 3) rotate / rewrap if needed.
lina: for step 1 I can run a binding export: `gcloud kms keys get-iam-policy partner-integ-2025 --location=global --project=redwood-sec` and cross-ref with our partner onboarding sheet. happy to take that.
sec_bot: :rotating_light: Alert created: SEC-2026-03-22-PARTNER-BLOB. Assigned to @maria and @lina. Triage checklist initialized.
maria: thanks @lina. I also grepped the backup manifest and saw `creds/db_readonly.enc` and `secrets/api_tokens.enc` — both look like wrapped blobs, no clear plaintext in the tar. still, threat model: if partner had a copy of the unwrapped artifacts somewhere, could be data-exfil.
ajay: prioritize audit logs. If KMS Decrypt/AsymmetricDecrypt calls don't show external IPs or unknown principals, lower risk. I'll pull Cloud Audit logs and filter: `resource.type="kms_keyring" protoPayload.methodName:"Decrypt" OR "AsymmetricDecrypt"` then grep for key name.
ops_oncall: also add Vault access logs — if those files were produced by an automated job that pulls secrets from Vault then writes them into backups, we need to know which Vault role/token was used. Add `VAULT_OPS` to the ticket.
lina: IAM bindings exported. two service accounts have cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter on that key: `partner-integ-sa@redwood-partners.iam.gserviceaccount.com` and `legacy-ci@redwood-infra.iam.gserviceaccount.com` (legacy-ci should be retired).
tom: legacy-ci is suspicious. schedule immediate key rewrap with new key and rotate both: plan = create new key `partner-integ-2026-rot1`, re-encrypt all ciphertext we control (prefix), update partner onboarding to use new key, revoke legacy-ci binding, rotate Vault wrapping token if applicable.
ajay: one caveat — cannot force-rewrap ciphertexts that partner holds. but for our stored backups we can rewrap to new key. also update audit-forwarder to include KMS request metadata to S3 audit stream for long-term retention.
maria: agreed. also want to push an RBAC tighten: remove `roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter` from broad groups; scope to specific service accounts only. I'll open a small PR and ping infra.
lina: started `gcloud kms keys create partner-integ-2026-rot1 --purpose=encryption`, ETA few mins. after create I'll run a dry rewrap script on staging copies:```bash
# dry run
python infra/tools/rewrap_kms.py --src-key partner-integ-2025 --dst-key partner-integ-2026-rot1 --dry-run --path=gs://partner-staging-backups/
```
sec_bot: Checkpoint: please update ticket SEC-2026-03-22-PARTNER-BLOB with artifacts: list of affected backups, IAM bindings export, audit log grep results, rewrap runbook link.
ops_oncall: I'm standing by to escalate if we see Decrypt from unknown principals; I'll also rotate the ephemeral CI tokens bound to `legacy-ci` once you revoke the IAM binding.
maria: follow-up plan: (A) inventory all backups in last 180d for similar blob signatures (B) run rewrap for our copies (C) revoke legacy-ci and rotate any linked tokens + Vault wrapping keys (D) tighten IAM and enable filter alerting on KMS Decrypts for partner key. Assigning tasks: lina = A+C, ajay = B+audit logs, tom = IAM and revoke flow, ops_oncall = token rotations + monitor.
ajay: pulling logs now — will post results in ticket and here. initial grep: 4 Decrypt entries in last 30d, all from legacy-ci SA from internal IP range. no external principals seen yet.
maria: ok that's helpful. still proceed with rewrap and rotation and schedule a 1hr postmortem tomorrow to review onboarding controls.
sec_bot: Postmortem reminder scheduled: 2026-03-23T16:00Z.
lina: dry-run finished, no failures. scheduling actual rewrap window 01:00-02:00 UTC to avoid load. I'll document rollback steps.
tom: once rewrap completes, we should update the partner contract note and require that partners rotate their copy if they confirm possession. also add a checklist item to onboarding: never store unwrapped secrets in backups.
maria: thanks all. closing loop: updated ticket with summary + next steps. will follow up after rewrap window. :white_check_mark:
